description: Cancel a project's scheduled deletion (delete_project or delete_graph_project), relational or graph. Nothing was removed, so the project is back as it was; refused when no deletion is scheduled. One operation runs on a project at a time: while another runs, the call is refused and the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: restore_project
title: Restore Project
